summary: Iteration 3 regression complete. PRIMARY GOAL VERIFIED: songs are FULL-LENGTH via Audius. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (test_iteration3.py). /api/tracks/{id}/stream returns audio/mpeg with Accept-Ranges: bytes AND Content-Length > 1MB (asserted >1_000_000 bytes on a live trending track — multi-MB, not a ~30s preview). Range requests return 206 with valid bytes. Trending tracks have duration > 60s (most are minutes-long). /api/artists/jayb1rdmusic returns the artist object with name/handle/image/followerCount/trackCount and its tracks. /api/tracks/trending?genre=Electronic, /api/tracks/search?q=lofi, and /api/lyrics?title=Believer&artist=Imagine%20Dragons&duration=204 all pass. Library flow on device_id=test_device_3 exercised end-to-end (GET → favorite toggle add/remove with GET verify → recent add → playlist create → add 3 tracks → reorder (reverse) → delete a track → unknown-playlist 404). Frontend (390x844 mobile web): home-screen loads, hero-card is present, genre-chip-Electronic tap works, tapping hero-card triggers audio and the mini-player appears; opening the player from the mini-player shows player-screen with all expected testIDs (player-play-toggle, player-next, player-prev, player-favorite, player-artist-link, player-lyrics-btn, seek-bar) AND the total-duration text visible on the Player is 60:03 (a full-length song, definitively not a 30s preview) with the current time advancing (0:09 shown). No deprecated Expo packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no React Native red screen. Only cosmetic 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation warnings from react-native-web (pre-existing).

issues: react-native-web 'shadow*' style-prop deprecation warnings in console (cosmetic, pre-existing).

critical_code_review_comments: stream_proxy correctly forwards Range header, sets Accept-Ranges: bytes, propagates content-length/content-range, and rotates Audius hosts on 4xx/5xx.
normalize_track uses Audius artwork.480x480 with 1000x1000 fallback and casts duration to int — trending tracks are consistently >60s.
Library endpoints are idempotent for a device_id (auto-creates on GET) and properly use $set updates; _id excluded via projection {_id: 0} — no ObjectId serialization issues.

Frontend audio-context uses previewUrl || streamUrl(id); Audius tracks have previewUrl=null so playback goes through /api/tracks/{id}/stream — verified full song loads (Player UI shows 60:03 duration and time advances).
seed_data_creation: device_id=test_device_3 library: created TEST_iter3_<uuid> playlist with 3 seed tracks, exercised reorder+delete, kept the playlist minus 1 track as residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py — covers the full-length assertion (Content-Length > 1MB) plus device_id=test_device_3 library flow. Tab bar labels are visible text (Home/Search/Sound/Library) — tab clicks won't work while player-screen (modal) is open; close it first via player-close. hero-card is a single testID (not hero-card-<id>). Equalizer switch testID is eq-enable-switch (not eq-enable). The Audius Content-Length can vary by track; some tracks may return 502 (unavailable) — tests iterate through trending until they find a streamable one.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issue. Full-length regression PASSED: Audius catalog returns multi-minute tracks; /stream proxy returns full MP3 (>1MB Content-Length) with Range support; frontend player renders the true duration (e.g. 60:03) and audio time advances.
